anonymization.accounts: Display labels use work-account/personal-account; identifier keys use work_account/personal_account.
anonymization.paths: Evidence paths are relative to the repository root; .. retains locations outside it. Historical commands anchor external paths at ${PWD}. Evidence was not copied or moved.
anonymization.history: Original timestamps, hashes, results and caveats are retained. Labels and paths are anonymized representations; historical verification does not attest to edited bytes or current live state.

source_scope: Same local worktree including existing user changes; no commit or push.
simplifications: Workspace ID alone is no longer individual login identity; unknown user identity never suppresses another profile.
Zero-credit caps no longer produce an exhausted allowance row; included windows and soft credit caps remain separate.
Accounts shortcuts reuse existing normalization; pending rename references use the fully migrated Account.

coverage: u -> Enter pins each profile's home
Ctrl-R replaces the changed usage percentage
different users in one workspace retain independent gauges
true duplicates retain explanations on weekly and credit rows
rename persists and preserves the auth sentinel
renamed profile launches on its migrated home

old_installed_0_55_0_baseline: Reproduced hidden second-user 65% gauge with shared workspace ID.
Reproduced ignored Korean physical r key in the Accounts modal.

limits: Existing 0.55.0 processes are not replaced or terminated; the new executable applies to new launches.
Renaming an account with an open pane remains blocked to protect its credential-directory migration.
Real user profiles were not renamed or deliberately relogged for testing; rename tests use isolated temporary homes.
Missing or delayed optional account/read identity preserves quota but skips shared-login deduplication.
